sam.docs: Heads-up: opened a docs PR to walk users through migrating from compact envelopes to explicit structured outputs. PR #4590. Need a quick sanity review on the schema examples and the migration snippet.

leah.pm: Link?

sam.docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4590 - draft includes: one canonical tool-call example, a minimal nullable-union schema, and a two-line migration snippet to map old envelope -> new shape. Trying to keep wording non-technical in the migration note.

ada.ml: I'll check the nullable union schema for edgecases (null vs missing). Recommend using an explicit discriminator field if possible.

ron.sre: Also think about a short ops note: guidance for fallback routing when parsing fails (e.g., route to low-cost model or return cached response). Can add that as a single bullet.

sam.docs: Good call. I'll add a 1-line ops bullet under "graceful degradation".

ada.ml: Quick nit: in the schema sample you marked `value` as required. For tool responses that sometimes return an error object, better to make `result` nullable and include `error_code` optional.

sam.docs: Noted. I'll switch `value` -> `result` and add an example of `{"result": null, "error_code": "NOT_FOUND"}`.

leah.pm: Small UX ask: add a tiny before/after code snippet showing how to call parseWithSchema in both TS and py so SDK users can copy/paste. Keep both <6 lines.

sam.docs: Will do TS + py 4-line snippets. Also adding a one-liner migration note: "if you previously read envelope.data, map to response.result and validate."

deploy-bot: link-checker: warning - long code line at /docs/migrate-envelopes.md line 42

sam.docs: I'll wrap the long line.

ada.ml: For guardrails section: include `additionalProperties: false` example and a short sentence about preferring typed fields for critical actions (deletes, payments).

ron.sre: Add an example policy snippet for rollout: if parse fails > 5% for 10m, automatically fallback to previous model. I'll paste a tiny policy in a follow-up.

leah.pm: Can we include a tiny test-case suggestion? e.g., add a prompt set that intentionally returns malformed JSON to ensure parsers are robust. One-line suggestion.

sam.docs: Good idea. I'll include a test note and link to our eval harness.

ada.ml: I pushed a couple inline comments on the PR: tighten enum for `status` and document where to put the discriminator.

sam.docs: Thanks. Anyone willing to merge once those are addressed + CI green? I have a backlog tomorrow morning, else I can merge tonight.

ron.sre: I'll monitor CI and merge if green and no unresolved comments.

deploy-bot: doc-build: running checks...

deploy-bot: doc-build: success - 0 errors, 2 warnings (long example line wrapped)
